signal: HSI unveiled Sky, an AI safety assistant, partnered with Enhesa, and earned SHRM accreditation for its training catalog in 2026

email.body1:
Pam, saw HSI launched Sky, partnered with Enhesa, and earned SHRM accreditation for its training catalog this year.

With that much new product and proof, business development usually has more in-market accounts than the team can cover, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for HSI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Pam, quick follow-up for HSI.

A wave of launches usually expands the target list faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit target, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings HSI needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Pam, last bit of proof for HSI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how HSI's reply rate likely compares to other safety and compliance software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Pam, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A run of launches like Sky is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a safety and compliance motion? I will tailor it to HSI either way.
